phase: Invitation acceptance and account password recovery
productionDecision: Existing production NO-GO preserved. No hosted deployment or live email activation in this phase.

requirements.requirement: Invite newly provisioned staff by email and require the recipient to accept the invitation.
requirements.uiReference: Existing EasyGas sign-in, Staff Management, Customers and account recovery
requirements.securityControl: Branch-scoped privileged invitation with fresh identity verification. Link and temporary password must match. Invitation acceptance leaves governed access approval in place.
requirements.reason: Browser and service tests verify encrypted queued email, acceptance, replay rejection and replacement credentials on resend.
requirements.testResult: PASS: Browser and service tests verify encrypted queued email, acceptance, replay rejection and replacement credentials on resend.
requirements.outstandingWork: Hosted mailbox delivery is tracked by ONBOARD-R05.

requirements.requirement: Email acceptance and a temporary password when staff create a customer account.
requirements.uiReference: Existing EasyGas sign-in, Staff Management, Customers and account recovery
requirements.dataSource: Customer user row, account challenge and transactional outbox.
requirements.securityControl: Scoped creator, one-time confirmation, 48-hour expiry and secure storage.
requirements.reason: Browser confirms the customer creation and acceptance flow. Service checks cover rejection before acceptance and after temporary password expiry.
requirements.testResult: PASS: Browser confirms the customer creation and acceptance flow. Service checks cover rejection before acceptance and after temporary password expiry.
requirements.outstandingWork: Hosted mailbox delivery is tracked by ONBOARD-R05.

requirements.requirement: Replace the temporary password before the first authenticated session.
requirements.uiReference: Existing EasyGas sign-in, Staff Management, Customers and account recovery
requirements.dataSource: Users, password hashes, temporary expiry and sessions.
requirements.securityControl: No valid session before password replacement. Reject matching replacement and replay. Preserve staff approval and native role scoping.
requirements.reason: Browser checked that no cookie exists before replacement. Service tests cover concurrent replacement and rejection of pre-issued sessions.
requirements.testResult: PASS: Browser checked that no cookie exists before replacement. Service tests cover concurrent replacement and rejection of pre-issued sessions.
requirements.outstandingWork: Installed-app UI acceptance is tracked by ONBOARD-R05.

requirements.requirement: Provide password reset for staff and customers.
requirements.scope: Staff and customer accounts with a registered email
requirements.uiReference: Existing EasyGas sign-in, Staff Management, Customers and account recovery
requirements.dataSource: Account challenges, auth attempt limits, users and sessions.
requirements.securityControl: Generic responses, atomic throttle, hashed 30-minute single-use reset token, session revocation and purpose separation.
requirements.reason: Staff and customer recovery, token invalidation and session revocation passed. Chrome reset worked during catalogue failure.
requirements.testResult: PASS: Staff and customer recovery, token invalidation and session revocation passed. Chrome reset worked during catalogue failure.
requirements.outstandingWork: Installed-app and hosted mailbox acceptance are tracked by ONBOARD-R05.

requirements.requirement: Verify hosted email delivery and installed mobile onboarding and recovery.
requirements.scope: Hosted web and installed iOS and Android
requirements.uiReference: Existing EasyGas sign-in, Staff Management, Customers and account recovery
requirements.route: Hosted SMTP worker and native login/recovery
requirements.dataSource: Authorised SMTP provider, transactional outbox and installed app sessions.
requirements.securityControl: Require TLS and keep email credentials and message encryption keys in server configuration.
requirements.reason: The local environment has no configured SMTP sender. Local browser acceptance used an isolated mailbox capture transport.
requirements.testResult: Local PostgreSQL and Chrome passed with a capture transport. Native TypeScript passed.
requirements.outstandingWork: Apply migration 077 on the hosted database. Configure the HTTPS APP_URL, SMTP sender and worker, and share the same message encryption key across API and worker. Verify delivery with approved test inboxes and test installed iOS and Android builds.

changeLog: The new flow extends existing staff invitation and account challenge routes. Legacy pending staff invites still accept a user-chosen password. Resending uses the new temporary-password flow. Existing role approvals and customer phone activation remain separate.
